motions.purpose: Step-by-step guided attention on a scientific figure: boxes/circles/arrows trace in, a spotlight scrim dims everything outside the region, an optional magnifier lens enlarges the detail, and the caption states the step's claim.
motions.model: Percent-coordinate SVG overlay on the figure; marks trace via stroke-dashoffset; the spotlight is an even-odd path with a hole; the lens is a scaled background-image crop of the same source.
motions.limitations: Marks are authored coordinates, not detected features; the lens magnifies pixels and adds no information.
motions.reducedMotion: No trace or scale animation; steps switch instantly and remain keyboard-driven.
motions.exportState: The declared exportStep (default: last step) rendered fully, caption included.
motions.accessibility: Arrow keys navigate steps (data-owns-arrows); the caption is aria-live; dots are labelled buttons; the figure carries the alt text.
